messages:
allegra: Heads-up: quick bring-up of saffron-compact-v2 with int6 per-channel. Short-query recall@10 slid 0.71 -> 0.67.

sam: Did you use clip-aware calibration or naive min-max?

allegra: Clip-aware with 2k calib samples, but we used per-channel symmetric quant.

morgan: Any change in neighbor ranks?

allegra: Median rank change ~2.4, 12% of queries had rank delta > 5. recall@100 stable (0.87 -> 0.86).

jess: Sounds like local shuffling. Try hybrid keep-norm-fp16 and per-channel for weights. Also run paraphrase/typo set.

kai: If recall@100 mostly intact, a routing policy with int6 for low-cost routes + fp16 fallback could work. Add a median-rank-change alert.

ci-bot: Kicked off follow-up runs (job 70123). Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/70123

allegra: Will post the per-variant table (recall@1/5/10/100, median-rank-change, %>5) and tsne after runs finish.
